stage: Exploratory frozen-model reassessment after historical normalization recovery; prior CPM outcomes were already observed
candidate_pool: The unchanged 96-donor baseline pool from SDY2823 / GSE279552

sf_reference.universe: All 23323 uniquely resolved measured genes in the frozen 30286-gene model-reference map, not only 4096 encoder features
sf_reference.rationale: Change normalization formula while retaining the mapped gene universe used by the old reference-CPM condition. This also follows the GDC preparation order of reference-gene projection before factor estimation.

sf_full_measured.universe: All 58302 unique measured Ensembl rows in the same 96 raw RNA libraries; map to the same 23323 model symbols only after factor estimation
sf_full_measured.rationale: Declared gene-universe sensitivity because the recovered GEO normalization precedes final model-gene selection. This is not claimed to recover an identical historical GEO annotation or gene universe.

normalization_formula: For genes positive in every candidate sample, take each gene's cohort mean log count; sample factor = exp(median gene log-ratio). Model input = log1p(count / sample factor).
normalization_fit_population: Exactly the locked 96 candidate libraries in both arms; no stimulated, longitudinal or excluded-donor libraries added
normalization_scope: Unsupervised whole-candidate-cohort fitting, explicitly transductive; not a training-only reference or prospective single-sample normalization contract
mapping_and_missing_policy: Unchanged model_gene_mapping_v2; uniquely resolved mappings only, no new identifier rescue or duplicate policy. Unresolved model features stay absent and retain the frozen model's zero-input convention; absence is not asserted to be biological zero.
precision: Float64 normalization and persisted mapped log inputs; each frozen encoder retains its existing float32 projection and clipping
runtime_input_scale: training_log, meaning already transformed values are passed through without a second log/CPM operation; this API label is not proof of distributional equivalence
anchor_contract: Both RNA branches receive the same preprocessed mapped values; structured anchor must be called with pretransformed=True and its alternate-CPM selection disabled

controls_primary_arm.rna_value_shuffled_sf_reference: Permute observed mapped log-expression gene values independently within each library, after the fixed cohort transform; direct RNA branch only
controls_primary_arm.rna_mismatched_sf_reference: Derange the assignment of primary direct RNA embeddings among candidate libraries; no self-pairings; not used as a model-robustness claim

text_construction: Same six complete, unedited fields and prefixes as full_portrait_v1; no query-specific field selection
queries: Score all unchanged 30 questions x 3 rewrites; evaluate only Q01, Q02, Q19 with the same measured T/B qrels

evaluation.primary: deterministic nDCG@10, descending score then ascending library ID
evaluation.mandatory_tie_sensitivity: exact equal-score random-order expectation for nDCG@10, Precision@10, Recall@10 and strong-discovery fraction
evaluation.aggregation: Mean rewrites within each question, then mean the three correlated questions; do not treat 9 rewrites as 9 independent biological experiments
evaluation.old_results: Retain all 17 methods/controls and exact prior v3 results; append 10 new named conditions without renaming or replacing prior CPM results

prohibited: Reading flow/qrel values during input preparation or model inference
Refitting weights, calibration, priors or prototypes
Dropping failed samples to improve metrics
Calling this a confirmatory trial or statement-correctness validation
remaining_gates: New held-out confirmatory queries/cohorts and practical utility
